answer: By the nadir of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, slashed on a failed audit, each submission carries a fresh nonce. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The lotus holds work receipts rather than names, so the wharf of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
